idea.title: QueryBuilder — SQL query builder CLI with visual syntax tree

plan.tagline: Build SQL queries visually in your terminal with instant syntax tree feedback
plan.problem: Developers waste hours debugging SQL syntax errors or writing complex queries from scratch, especially when working with unfamiliar databases or APIs
plan.solution: A CLI tool that lets you construct SQL queries step-by-step with visual feedback, error checking, and reusable components—all offline with hardcoded demo data
plan.target_market: Indie hackers and small dev teams building data-driven apps who need quick, reliable SQL without heavy IDEs or cloud services
mvp_features: Interactive query builder with step-by-step prompts
Export queries to clipboard or file
plan.demo_script: Run `querybuilder --demo` to see a 3-table schema, build a JOIN query step-by-step, and export the final SQL to clipboard
plan.phuket_angle: Thai small businesses (e.g., tour operators) can use it to quickly build custom reports from their SQLite-based booking systems without hiring SQL experts
